mapper.select: SELECT blackmark.blackmarkid, blackmark.blackmark, blackmark.blackmarkname, blackmark.point, blackmark.reason, DATE_FORMAT(blackmark.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark blackmark WHERE blackmark.memberid = #{memberid} AND blackmark.cancelyn = 'N' ORDER BY blackmark.regdate DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT blackmark.blackmarkid, blackmark.blackmark, blackmark.blackmarkname, blackmark.point, blackmark.reason, DATE_FORMAT(blackmark.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.blackmark blackmark WHERE blackmark.blackmarkid = #{blackmarkid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.blackmark ( branchid, blackmark, blackmarkname, point, reason, memberid, userid, regdate ) VALUES ( #{session_branchid}, #{blackmark}, #{blackmarkname}, ${point}, #{reason}, #{memberid}, #{userid}, now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ttokssaemdb.blackmark SET canceldate = now(), cancelyn = 'Y', canceluserid = #{userid} WHERE blackmarkid = #{blackmarkid}
